fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/tui/inboxapp with a fake runner: a row per inbox item in order; Enter on a question, gate, signoff, failed or accept item opens that item's action; Enter on a stalled, overlap, disk-low, usage-reserve or main-stale item shows its detail and asks the runner to open its run's tab; an empty inbox shows one empty-state line; the tui-inbox-app testscript compares rhiza tui app inbox --once with rhiza inbox --json byte for byte.
fields.statement: The Inbox app lists every inbox item as one rexuikit List, a row per item with its kind, change set title and what it waits for; Enter picks the item and opens its action (answer for questions and gates, sign-off, retry or abandon for a failed run, accept for an accept item), and any other kind shows its detail and opens the run's tab; --once prints what rhiza inbox --json prints.

fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/tui/inboxapp with a fake runner: Approve on a signoff item calls run.approve with its run and the app quits; Send back with a note calls run.send-back with the run and the note and quits; Send back with an empty note is refused; Esc calls nothing.
fields.statement: Picking a sign-off opens a rexuikit Dialog naming the run and what it waits for, with Approve and Send back: Approve signs it off through run.approve and Send back takes a note through run.send-back, either then closing the app; Esc closes it with nothing done.

fields.acceptance: A testscript (run-send-back.txtar) with a fake claude drives a ship-change run to signoff, runs rhiza run send-back with a note, and shows the note in rhiza run status as a finding, the run's next step a fixer, and no signoff journaled; send-back on a run not at signoff exits non-zero and changes nothing.
fields.statement: rhiza run send-back <run> --note <text> sends a run waiting at a signoff step back to a fixer: the note is journaled as the next review round's findings, the run returns to its review fixer step instead of signing off, and the continuation is queued for the daemon.
